_comment: Sanitised CruzSync agent traces, generated by `tsx scripts/gen-trace.ts` from real runs against the committed demo fixtures. Contains NO chain-of-thought: only the tools the agent called, redacted arguments, timings, sources and one-line result summaries. Rider free text is redacted inside `args`; the top-level `riderMessage` is included deliberately because it is the demo prompt, not private user data.
note: origin "fixture" means the underlying real-time evidence is labelled demonstration data.
